note: Section numbers and titles are from the Municipal Code of Chicago (American Legal, 2026 S-74). sections.title: Certified Plan Corrections (Department of Buildings process)
sections.scope: Not a code section. Standard Plan Review applications use this program for most corrections after a full review. The design professional revises the drawings for each correction, and bubbles, dates and initials each change. Certification is on Form 420, signed and sealed by each professional of record. It excludes zoning, geotechnical and stormwater items, incomplete applications, and disputed comments. No response within 120 days means withdrawal. Source: chicago.gov Department of Buildings pages, seen through search excerpts; confirm before relying on this.

sections.title: Former Title 13 (legacy building code)
sections.scope: Not a current citation for most work. The Title 14 series (14A, 14B, and others) replaced it; the Chicago Building Code in 14B applies to most permit applications started on or after August 1, 2020. Convert a Title 13 reference to the current section that covers the same subject.
